personality_one_liner: A structured, highly readable, and native-feeling educational environment that puts the content front and center.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content, safe area clearance at root, sticky CTAs get bottom padding so they don't cover scrolling content. Elements follow a 4pt/8pt grid rhythm.

do's: Sticky Continue primary CTA in Lesson
Glass header on bottom sheets for quizzes

screens.name: Courses Tab
screens.purpose: Dashboard to view overall progress and browse the 13 Python modules.
screens.layout: Use a Bento/grid-style header for overall completion %. Below it, a vertical list of 13 module cards. Each card uses `surfaceSecondary`, 16px radius, showing title, lesson count, and a linear progress bar. Ensure safe area at top.

screens.name: Module Detail
screens.purpose: List lessons within a specific module.

states.empty: No lessons found in this module.

screens.layout: Stack layout. Large title header (collapses on scroll). Vertical list of lessons. Each row (min 56pt height) shows lesson title, completion state (checkmark icon if completed), and chevron. Clean dividers between rows.

screens.name: Lesson Detail
screens.purpose: Read lesson content, key points, and take the quiz.
screens.layout: Scrollable view. Title + Body text in `Geist`, code snippets in `JetBrains Mono` on `surfaceSecondary` blocks. 'Mark Complete' and 'Take Quiz' primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom over a glass blur container. Quiz triggers a Bottom Sheet.

screens.name: Quiz Bottom Sheet
screens.layout: Pulls up via `@gorhom/bottom-sheet`. Shows one question at a time. 4 options as selectable `surfaceSecondary` cards. Upon selection, reveal explanation (success/error color styling) and Next Question button. Score shown at the end.

screens.name: Progress Tab
screens.purpose: Visualize user's learning journey, streaks, and overall score.

states.empty: Take a lesson to see progress.

screens.layout: Bento/grid-style modular layout. Large card for Streak (flame icon + day count). Circular progress for overall %. Grid of smaller cards for quiz scores. Sticky 'Continue Learning' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Settings Tab
screens.layout: Native iOS grouped list layout. `surfaceSecondary` rows inside a `surfaceTertiary` (or pure white on iOS) background depending on pure native styling. Rows for Dark Mode Toggle, Clear Local Data, About.

hero_course_bg_dark.alt: Vibrant and detailed view of JavaScript code on a screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. Strict safe-area spacing and generous whitespace.
Implement the Python color scheme using the exact tokens provided (`brand`: #3776AB, `brandSecondary`: #FFD43B). Do NOT default to generic React Native blue.
Bento/grid-style modular layouts should be used for the Progress Tab and Courses header, heavily inspired by modern 2026 UI trends.
Ensure dark mode toggle is functional and maps perfectly to the `color_dark` tokens.
Quiz should be implemented as an interactive bottom sheet over the Lesson view.
Always place a gradient scrim under text that overlays images, using a 3-stop linear gradient as specified in the rules.
All primary CTAs over scrollable content (like 'Continue' or 'Mark Complete') must be placed in a sticky bottom container using a glass-blur effect with proper safe area inset.
